name: sprint16_qhour_open_altcoins
hypothesis: Extends sprint09's qhour-boundary VWAP-slicing periodicity mechanism (arXiv 2607.09426, majors FAIL) to the same 8-alt basket used in sprint04/sprint13, closing the last untested cell in the 5-signal x {majors,alts} coverage matrix.
power_argument: Using C0/C1 dispersion (~33bp std) and T2 floor (~26bp): min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 is ~3.8bp, well below cost floor. 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap8/day = up to 5888 possible entries; sprint04/sprint13 realized 5888/7269 trades under identical caps on this basket, so n>=300 is near-certain.
